explain.selection: Begin the morning by saying to thyself, I shall meet with the busybody, the ungrateful, arrogant, deceitful, envious, unsocial.
explain.answer:
Marcus is rehearsing the day before it starts. He lists the people who will annoy him — the meddler, the ungrateful, the arrogant — so that none of them catches him off guard.

The point comes next: they behave this way because they don't know good from bad, and they are still his kin. Expecting it lets him stay calm instead of angry.

beats.title: Prepare for the day
beats.text: Expect difficult people. They act from ignorance, and they are still your kin.

beats.title: Time is short
beats.text: Stop drifting. Do each thing as if it were the last thing you do.

beats.title: Only the present
beats.text: You can only lose the moment you are living in, so no one loses more than that.

beats.title: Guard your mind
beats.text: The ruling part within you is what matters: keep it free of anger and distraction.
